A hectic block ahead, a few notes
The subject is staff briefings
Travelers need to know that Aurelia Skyways keeps companion animal care steady, calm, and closely watched from booking through pickup.

Companion Animal Travel Desk update

Our handlers use calm, humane methods and keep each animal's comfort in mind at every step. Plans are set around species, temperament, and any special care needs, so the trip feels settled rather than rushed. A safety coordinator also checks for hazards and helps staff prevent avoidable stress during the journey.

If you are traveling with a pet, please keep your booking details handy and share any useful notes with the desk. Clear information helps us match the care plan to the animal and keep the handoff smooth for everyone involved. We also make sure pickup is simple and easy to follow once travel is complete.

For help with travel plans, care notes, or arrival questions, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
